value.rationale: The claim exposes a concrete representational limitation of a cardinality-minimal finite model of a classical space: although the torus mapping class group contains shears, the standard 16-point model realizes only signed-permutation automorphisms on H1. The exact self-map census and matrix image make the obstruction reusable when deciding whether refinement/enlargement is necessary for finite-space dynamics.
